spells.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
spells.effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
